column1: # PlasBench replication cohort: the 53 Escherichia coli isolates of the PlasEval paper
# (Mane et al. 2024, BMC Bioinformatics 25:365, doi 10.1186/s12859-024-05941-0; data: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10785150, CC BY 4.0).
# Isolates are from Saskatchewan broiler farms (Sanderson et al. 2023, Microbiol Resour Announc 12:e0011023,
# doi 10.1128/mra.00110-23; BioProject PRJNA912639). The accessions come from the paper's Ecoli_samples.csv.
# assembly_plasmid_count is the number of plasmid bins in the ground truth released on Zenodo (184 over 53 isolates).
# The paper's text reports 190 plasmids with a mean length of 48,365 bp; the released files give 184 bins with a mean of 48,908 bp,
# so the two differ slightly (the released version may have been filtered). In the released truth 246 contigs sit in more than one bin.
# Truth: Unicycler hybrid assemblies. Unicycler builds on the short-read graph and the same Illumina reads are the benchmark input,
# so truth_assembly_strategy is short_read_first_hybrid and truth_polish_reads is same_as_benchmark: this cohort is a replication
# panel for the binning comparison, not a headline panel (reference tier 3; base-level identity metrics do not apply).
# long_read_sra_run is carried for provenance; it is not used for the default short-read benchmark.
# NOT yet validated online: run  plasbench validate-cohort --samples cohorts/plaseval-ecoli53.tsv --online --write-lock
# (needs your NCBI email) before citing a result. truth_quality_tier is B (no reviewed source study) until that review is done.
